messages:
oncall-bot: 🚨 INC-1799123456 — High error rate: continuous-batcher in us-east-1 showing repeated CUDA OOMs + container restarts. Pager triggered. Aggregate errors 8.4% over 5m, p95 latency > 10s. Notified #incidents.

mira (oncall): I’m on it. Confirming impacted service: inference/runtime-continuous-batcher. Any customer-facing alerts yet? @ellie (support)

ellie (support): Support: a handful of customers reported slow responses and 502s — two enterprise tenants with heavy streaming traffic. CS is drafting a short advisory. Will share once done.

aldo (eng-runtime): seeing repeated logs: `cudaRuntime: out of memory` inside container, and kube restarting pod. Also observed batch queue length climbing to 80k before OOM. Looks like continuous-batcher growth loop + long seq requests.

jess (sre-lead): Node flaps: 3 nodes in us-east-1 went NotReady after repeated OOMs, they recovered but kubelet restarted containers repeatedly. Investigating node-level OOM or GPU driver.

tom (eng-platform): grabbed `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=continuous-batcher -o wide`: many on node gpu-e-3. Running `kubectl logs` shows batch assembly stalls.

aldo (eng-runtime): quick mitigation proposal: flip the feature-flag `CONT_BATCHER_ENABLE=false` to force per-request batching (disable continuous batching) -> immediate reduction in batch growth. Then scale up fallback-variant nodes while we debug.

mira (oncall): @tom can you toggle flag and do a rolling restart of the continuous-batcher deployment? We need quick action.

tom (eng-platform): doing it now. Command I ran:

```
kubectl set env deployment/continuous-batcher CONT_BATCHER_ENABLE=false -n inference
kubectl rollout restart deployment/continuous-batcher -n inference
```

tom (eng-platform): rollout started. Pods terminating & coming up. Watching health.

oncall-bot: action taken by tom at 1799123520 — CONT_BATCHER_ENABLE=false. Noted in incident timeline.

mira (oncall): monitoring metrics. p95 latency dropping. Error rate trending down from 8.4% -> 1.2% in 3m. Good sign. Reassign to eng-runtime to root-cause.

aldo (eng-runtime): confirming: with continuous batching off we no longer see the large queue accumulation. Looking at traces: a compaction path that merges prefix-KV + long-seq requests can create a pathological work item that never drains — leads to unbounded memory (%heap+GPU) growth.

jess (sre-lead): temporary customer impact: ~5 customers had errors during the spike; two enterprise customers affected for ~12 minutes. CS has initial message out. Tagging this Sev2 for now.

ops-bot: Incident tag updated: sev=2, status=mitigated, owner=eng-runtime.

aldo (eng-runtime): attempt to reproduce locally with stress harness. Repro steps show a deadlock between batch scheduler and KV cache eviction under specific ordering of requests. Patch candidate: cap reconstructed batch size and add a backpressure token to queue assembler.

mira (oncall): what about CUDA OOMs on node — driver or container? jess?

jess (sre-lead): nodes show GPU memory not fully freed due to stale contexts from crashed containers; kernel driver shows many mallocs. We rolled affected nodes through `drain -> reboot -> uncordon` to clear GPU state on 3 nodes. Doing a controlled cordon now to avoid further flaps.

tom (eng-platform): cordoned node gpu-e-3-1 and gpu-e-3-2. Reboot scheduled via cloud provider. Rolling scale up of fallback fleet by +4 small-GPU instances to handle traffic while we keep continuous batching disabled.

aldo (eng-runtime): posting quick patch to runtime repo, branch `fix/batcher-cap-bp-1799`. Patch includes:

```
- add config: runtime.max_continuous_batch_tokens = 4096
- enqueue: if projected_batch_tokens > max -> apply immediate backpressure and fail early with 429
- scheduler: add periodic queue-scan to break potential deadlocks
```

aldo (eng-runtime): running unit+integration tests now. If green, prefer to hotpatch nonblocking change rather than full rollout.

mira (oncall): timeline note: initial alert 1799123456, flag disabled 1799123520, errors dropped below 2% 1799123540. Keep track for postmortem.

ellie (support): CS update ready. Sent advisory to affected customers: apologies, brief description, mitigation steps, ETA for full fix. Two enterprise customers requested post-incident call.

tom (eng-platform): cloud provider shows some IO paging spikes correlated to pods on node gpu-e-3-1 — looks like kernel page-outs when container memory ballooned. Reboots completed, nodes back healthy.

ops-bot: deployment patch rolled to canary at 1799123860 (1 pod). Monitoring canary: canary stable with patched cap.

aldo (eng-runtime): canary logs look clean. No deadlock observed for stress harness. Rolling patch to 25% then full if no regressions.

mira (oncall): current status: continuous-batcher disabled (flag), runtime patch rolling, nodes healthy, traffic routed to fallback. Impact low but follow-up required. Assigning RCA to eng-runtime + eng-platform. @aldo @tom

aldo (eng-runtime): Will draft RCA. Immediate next steps: 1) make the runtime cap permanent (config + tests), 2) add e2e test for batch-growth pattern, 3) add dashboard alert if batch-queue > 10k.

jess (sre-lead): Ops follow-ups: add automated node GPU reset playbook for rapid recovery; add alerting on node paging/IOps spike. Also evaluate OOMKill thresholds to avoid entire node flaps.

mira (oncall): Handoff: I'm wrapping shift. Night oncall @liam will take over at 1800000000. Summary for handoff:
- Mitigated (flag off) at 1799123520
- Patch rolling (branch fix/batcher-cap-bp-1799), canary stable as of 1799123860
- Nodes rebooted and healthy
- Customer impact: short (~12m) elevated errors for ~5 tenants, two enterprise concerned
- Action items: watch canary, finish rollout, close incident after postmortem

liam (oncall-night): I got it. I'll watch metrics and complete the rollout. If batcher flag needs to be re-enabled, coordinate with eng-runtime. Thanks @mira.

mira (oncall): tagging postmortem owners: aldo (eng-runtime), tom (eng-platform), jess (sre-lead), ellie (support). Please capture timeline + lessons. Closing Slack updates; keep channel for follow-up.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-1799123456 status=handed-off, owner=liam, sev=2, timestamp=1799124120

liam (oncall-night): Quick note before I go fully offline — monitoring alert rule added: `continuous_batch_queue_len > 10000 for 2m` -> paged to eng-sre. Also created runbook entry under docs/ops/batcher-emergency.md referencing the backpressure toggle and node reboot steps.

aldo (eng-runtime): included test vectors in PR. I’ll post the PR link in the incident doc. Preparing detailed RCA draft.

ellie (support): Following up with affected customers to schedule calls. Marking incident in the customer impact tracker.

jess (sre-lead): final: keep CONT_BATCHER disabled until patch fully rolled and we validate e2e. We'll reconvene for the postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
